Individual dispositions
S=qualified conservative lexical support ONLY; U=direct support not demonstrated. EVERY pair, including author-labelled D pairs, retains UNVERIFIED ordinary modern quiz suitability/necessity/frequency/future uniqueness. S does not mean all senses interchangeable.
Q001 S おつり–あまり: payment change/remainder noun restricted to あまり, not あんまり or negative-degree adverb (1584930).
Q002 S とこや–店: barbershop/establishment versus standalone みせ; not barber-person/suffix てん.
Q003 S アルコール–お酒: alcoholic drink versus polite おさけ; not chemical/disinfectant alcohol.
Q004 S アルコール–飲み物: alcoholic beverage within のみもの only, not every alcohol substance/drink.
Q005 S 代わり–取り替える: かわり replacement versus とりかえる replacing action; preserve noun/action syntax and の代わりに.
Q006 S 席–いす: せき seat/chair; both independently record post/office domains. Floor seating need not be a chair.
Q007 S 席–場所: gathering-location/place versus ばしょ; not sumo or every place as a physical seat.
Q008 S 席–所: standalone ところ location, not しょ/じょ counter/suffix.
Q009 S 席–会場: gathering location versus かいじょう venue, not merely a chair inside it.
Q010 S 席–ポスト: separately attested post/position nouns; not mailbox, goalpost, online posting/post- prefix.
Q011 S 席–仕事: post versus しごと job/employment role only; not all labour/tasks/physics work, nor inheritance through ポスト.
Q012 S 戦争–競争: せんそう fierce-competition sense versus きょうそう competition, not literal-war equivalence.
Q013 S 喧嘩–戦争: けんか fighting versus independently recorded fighting sense; not every quarrel a war/no 喧嘩–競争 inference.
Q014 S 故障–壊れる: こしょう breakdown versus こわれる; distinguish event, resulting state and actor-caused breaking.
Q015 S 故障–怪我: actual injury versus けが; respect body-part/patient restrictions and transitive injury sense, not equipment grammar.
Q016 S 故障–問題: actual trouble/hitch versus もんだい trouble; not all questions/research subjects.
Q017 S 故障–反対: actual objection/protest versus はんたい objection, not reverse direction.
Q018 S 故障–壁: obstacle/hindrance versus かべ barrier, not physical walls/astronomical へき.
Q019 S 故障–だめ: broken/not-serving-purpose only, not prohibition/interjection/Go neutral points.
Q020 S 用–用事: よう standalone business/errand versus ようじ, not N用 suffix/excretion.
Q021 S 用–仕事: standalone business/task versus しごと, not 仕事用 compound lifting/physics work.
Q022 S 用–利用: standalone use noun versus りよう utilization noun/する, not errands/unrestricted exploitation.
Q023 S 用–使う: use noun versus つかう action; no necessity sense/grammatical interchangeability.
Q024 S 規則–法律: きそく rules versus ほうりつ law, narrow normative domain; school rules need not be legislation.
Q025 S 規則–約束: やくそく convention/rule noun, not all promises/appointments/destiny.
Q026 S 関係–連絡: かんけい relation versus れんらく FORMAL/LITERARY connection-between-matters, not messages/train connections.
Q027 S 関係–間: standalone あいだ relationship, not ま room/pause/counter readings/suffix lifting.
Q028 S 関係–左右: independent influence/effect versus さゆう influence/control, not directions/rare とかく・とにかく readings/identical transitivity.
Q029 S 失敗–間違える: しっぱい mistake/blunder versus まちがえる making an error; failed undertaking need not equal wrong detail.
Q030 U 失敗–違う: ちがう1158880 sense2 is a wrong/incorrect STATE; 失敗1320140 a mistake/blunder or unsuccessful ATTEMPT. An error-domain label does not demonstrate direct equivalence. Not all differences/wrong states are failures; no inheritance through 間違える.
Q031 S 失敗–落ちる: おちる exam/contest failure, not physical falling/unrelated endings.
Q032 S 失敗–滑る: すべる exam failure or COLLOQUIAL joke falling flat; not sliding/slipping/ぬめる sliminess. Preserve register.
Q033 S 失敗–怪我: けが independently records mistake/accident/loss, not only injury/no inference through 故障.
Q034 S 答–返事: こたえ reply noun versus へんじ response; not every solution/result a conversational reply.
Q035 S 答–答える: こたえ noun versus こたえる answering action; bare 答 is not a verb.
Q036 S 答–返す: かえす independently records responding/retorting, not physical return/suffix 返す.
Q037 S 答–受ける: うける sense13 GO-GAME answering/responding action ONLY versus response noun; not receiving/taking exams/inheritance from 答える. No ordinary general-response usage established.

15 NO_PAIR decisions
Retain 故障–壊す for equipment event/causation, not universal denial of injury senses; 故障–失敗 for malfunction/failed attempt; 喧嘩–競争 because 戦争 creates no transitive closure.
Retain 用–要る/必要 (no standalone necessity), 用–役に立つ (use/purpose versus usefulness), 席–出席/座る (entity/post versus attendance/sitting/assuming-post action).
Retain 輸入–輸出 (opposite directions), 輸入–入れる and 輸出–出す (generic/component meanings do not establish international trade).
Retain 貿易–取り替える/買い物 (commerce versus ordinary swap/shopping), 関係–結婚 (relationship/marriage), 失敗–だめ (attempt versus useless/broken state/prohibition).
Retain 消しゴム–消す/鉛筆 (tool/action/pencil), 天気予報–天気 (forecast/actual weather).
Qualify 消しゴム–ゴム: no CURRENT pair because ゴム is absent. Whole EN body/JMdict1054570 sense2 attest standalone eraser abbreviation. Material-versus-item cannot justify a universal negative; tighten the rationale. No absent provider approved/required.
